ipa.financial_contracts.cross.LegDefinition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cross.LegDefinition.

Syntax

LegDefinition(
    *,
    start_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    end_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    tenor: str | None = None,
    leg_tag: str | None = None,
    deal_ccy_buy_sell: BuySell | str = None,
    fx_leg_type: FxLegType | str = None,
    contra_amount: float | None = None,
    contra_ccy: str | None = None,
    deal_amount: float | None = None,
    deal_ccy: str | None = None,
    start_tenor: str | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None
end_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The maturity date of the contract that is the date the amounts are exchanged. Either the end_date or the tenor must be provided.
tenor str | None No None The tenor representing the maturity date of the contract (e.g. '1Y' or '6M' ). Either the end_date or the tenor must be provided.
leg_tag str | None No None A user defined string to identify the leg. Optional.
deal_ccy_buy_sell BuySell | str No None The direction of the trade in terms of the deal currency. Optional. Defaults to 'Buy'
fx_leg_type FxLegType | str No None The enumeration that specifies the type of the leg. Mandatory for MultiLeg, FwdFwdSwap, or Swap contracts. Optional for Spot and Forwards contracts.
contra_amount float | None No None The unsigned amount exchanged to buy or sell the traded amount. Optional. By default, it is calculated from the traded rate and the deal_amount. If no traded rate is provided the market rate will be used.
contra_ccy str | None No None The currency that is exchanged. Optional. By default, the second currency in the FxCrossCode.
deal_amount float | None No None The unsigned amount of traded currency actually bought or sold. Optional. Defaults to 1,000,000'.
deal_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the traded currency (e.g. 'EUR' ). Optional. Defaults to the first currency of the FxCrossCode.
start_tenor str | None No None The tenor representing the Starting of maturity period of the contract (e.g. '1Y' or '6M' ). Either the start_date or the start_tenor must be provided for TimeOptionForward.
